candidates.spoken: What If You Spent a Summer in Death Valley?
Without shade and water, heat stroke comes quickly.
The famous 1913 record is now disputed.
Summer nights often stay between 28 and 37 °C.
It's the highest reliable temperature recorded there.
A person stayed through a Death Valley summer.
The real cause was a deep.
It would not all happen at once.
So the danger isn't one hot afternoon.

script.spoken: Death Valley hit 54.4 °C in 2020. It's the highest reliable temperature recorded there. The famous 1913 record is now disputed. Summer nights often stay between 28 and 37 °C. In 2001, it logged 154 straight days of at least 38 °C. Without shade and water, heat stroke comes quickly. Your body cools by sweating, and dry air speeds it up. So the danger isn't one hot afternoon. It's heat that never breaks.
